title: 1. Test seedless generator transfer to grasp-and-transport
hypothesis: Single-phase generation preserves grasp-to-transport coordination better than ideas-then-implementation generation, giving rollout search better pick-place-v2 structures without a seed bank.

prediction.rationale: Baseline is two-phase generation with identical rollout search. A 15-point fresh-case gain would justify transferring the recipe. D-014 tested pushing, not grasp transitions, and D-015's saturated bank cannot answer this question. This direct transfer decision has the highest expected information value.

falsified_by: The block-level paired 95% interval has an upper bound below +0.15. An interval spanning zero is inconclusive, not evidence of improvement; resolving it requires fresh-case paired success from additional independent generation blocks.
